lead_basis: Leads 1-2: all five primary metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1 >= 75%; AUC >= 0.75) pass pooled over the ENNS 2018, 2019 and 2021 walk-forward rounds (owner rule, 2026-11-13). From Lead 3 pooled precision (73.1%) and F1 (74.5%) fall below 75%. No lead passes in every single round (2018 precision 72.7%; 2021 recall 25%).
approved_by: owner instruction in chat, 2026-11-13: use the approved FINAL LightGBM model in production on branch aiPHeed/final-model-completion-20261113
caveat: Retrospective validation on 72 province-rounds (3 survey rounds); 2021 HIGH recall 1 of 4; not independently validated.

2026-Q4.note: Superseded. This forecast (cut-off 1 November 2026) used October 2026 consumer prices (PSA CPI, released 5 November) and September 2026 unemployment (PSA LFS, released 6 November), published after its cut-off. It is kept unchanged in the history and replaced by the forecast issued 10 November 2026, which uses only figures published before that day.

issue_rule_basis: Owner instruction 2026-11-14: the data used for the forecast are updated, and a new forecast issued, on the 10th of every month at 00:00 Philippine time, from figures published before that moment. Until 2026-11-14 the rule was quarterly (1st of each quarter's second month); the 2026-Q4 issue (cut-off 1 Nov 2026) was made under it.
cadence_caveat: FINAL's walk-forward validation issued each forecast on the 1st of the quarter's second month. Monthly forecasts issued on other dates use the same model and lead definition (target = the issue date's quarter + lead) but slightly more or less information; they have not been validated separately.
